failure_reason: bloomingdales.com returns HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (Akamai Bot Manager) on every /shop/ page tested via direct HTTP (curl_cffi, multiple browser TLS impersonations) and via Playwright/CDP. Claude-in-Chrome loads an Akamai JS-challenge interstitial ('Powered and protected by Akamai') that never resolves - the page never reaches document_idle even after 20+ seconds, consistent with automation/CDP detection, not a solvable interactive CAPTCHA (no such control appeared; a single incidental click on the only visible element had no effect and no further challenge interaction was attempted, per the CAPTCHA/bot-detection prohibition). robots.txt (200) and the site's own sitemap XML endpoints (200) are NOT behind this block and were used for tier-1 structured-data discovery, but no product-listing page could actually be rendered to confirm genuine-PLP status or capture an exact qty for any candidate.
notes: robots.txt checked first: no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot disallow of '/' - only 'Crawl-delay: 5' for ClaudeBot - so no policy_opt_out. Access tiers tried in order and all failed for actual page content: (1) HTTP - curl_cffi with chrome120/124/edge101/safari15_5/chrome99_android impersonation, with and without a prior homepage visit for cookies, all returned 403 on both the homepage and every /shop/ URL tested; (2) Playwright/CDP (headless chromium, spoofed UA/viewport/webdriver flag) - same 403 on homepage and target category page; (3) Claude-in-Chrome - real Chrome shows the Akamai 'Powered and protected by' interstitial and never finishes loading (get_page_text/screenshot both time out waiting for document_idle) on both the assigned site_url and a Christmas-Shop subpage. Given the full block, rows below were identified from bloomingdales.com's OWN category sitemap (https://www.bloomingdales.com/dyn_img/sitemap/bcom_sitemap_cat_aa.xml.gz, fetched via plain HTTP - not archive/proxy), which Bloomingdale's own sitemap-index separates from its PDP, facet, and registry sitemaps, i.e. these URLs are the site's own canonical category-page set. This is first-party structured evidence of category EXISTENCE only - it does not confirm a page is a genuine non-marketing PLP nor provide any qty, so every row below carries qty:null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag. Sitemap URL 'https://www.bloomingdales.com/shop/the-christmas-shop/artificial-christmas-trees?id=1288002' duplicates the slug of id=1283804 (kept, matches the sequential id numbering of its sibling rows 1283802-1283808); the id=1288002 duplicate was dropped per the shared overlap rule (Rule 0.6 / seasonal.md SS13-14). Excluded from rows as out-of-scope/marketing despite seasonal-looking sitemap slugs: all 'gifts/*-gifts-for-*' and 'gifts/valentines-day-gifts-*'/'mothers-day-gifts-*'/'fathers-day-gifts-*' (cross-department gift-guide/recipient pages, not a Home category), 'stocking-stuffers' (cross-department gift-guide page), 'kids/halloween' and 'kids/easter' (Kids apparel/costumes, not Home), 'womens-apparel/festive-holiday-sweaters' and 'womens-apparel/holiday-dresses' (apparel), 'makeup-perfume-beauty/beauty-advent-calendars' (Beauty dept), 'registry-ideas/thanksgiving-feast' and 'registry-ideas/new-years-celebration' (gift registry, not a product category), 'fashion-lookbooks-videos-style-guide/lunar-new-year-shop', '/holiday-parties', '/fourth-of-july-shop' (site's own 'lookbooks' branch - Lookbooks are on the shared NEVER EXTRACT list), 'ralph-lauren/holiday-family-dressing' (brand apparel), 'sale/black-friday-deals' (Sale, on the NEVER EXTRACT list), 'home/spring-break-essentials' (travel/lifestyle theme, not a holiday), 'home/holiday-dinner-party' (reads as an entertaining/lifestyle landing page, not a product category - excluded rather than guessed). No Diwali/Eid/Diwali-adjacent Indian-festival or Easter(non-kids)/Valentine's/Mother's/Father's Day Home-department category was found in the category sitemap. Because the whole site could not be rendered, this is NOT a proven NO_SEASONAL for any holiday not listed below - only what the sitemap slugs surfaced could be checked at all.
